items.supporting_quote: This document constitutes MODULE 2.4 — NONCLINICAL OVERVIEW of the Common Technical Document (CTD) format as specified in ICH M4 guidelines for the biologics license application (BLA) of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) submitted by Moderna, Inc. to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The submission follows the eCTD format as required by 21 CFR Part 314 and FDA guidance on eCTD submissions.
